# .github

This directory contains GitHub-specific configuration files for the repository.

## Contents

- **[ISSUE_TEMPLATE/](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/)** – Templates for creating new GitHub issues (community issues, core contributor issues, and feature gate requests).
- **[workflows/](workflows/)** – GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow definitions (builds, tests, releases, dependency updates, etc.).
- **[PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)** – Default pull request description template.
- **[RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md](RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md)** – Template used when drafting release notes.
- **[dependabot.yml](dependabot.yml)** – Dependabot configuration for automated dependency updates.
- **[label-actions.yml](label-actions.yml)** – Automated actions triggered by issue/PR label changes.
